title: Opaque declaration helpers and keys
setup_and_action: F-START: record the unresolved helper/key boundary. Do not replace symbolic tags with guessed strings/values or convert omitted auto-load declarations into False.

title: Actual device matching and applicability
setup_and_action: F-IDENTITY: separately establish a genuine accepted same-model device/host/firmware and positive startup baseline before any mismatch or unavailable-device probe; no hardware or detection is supplied.

title: Port ordering flag and direction effects
setup_and_action: F-PORT: use independently accepted active positive port paths first; separately retain real OS names/order and settings without equating them to source-list positions or imported flags.

title: Module creator and initialization lifecycle
setup_and_action: F-START: actual eligible Live/framework/controller initialization needs separate evidence and authorization; no class, creator or reconstructed function is invoked or simulated.

title: MIDI controls feedback and output
setup_and_action: F-SIGNAL: before future events/no-effect observations require independently valid nonempty source, active supported target/input and nonzero amount/gain plus nonmuted output and productive MIDI/feedback baseline; no script or hardware is run.

title: Failures cancellation persistence and teardown
setup_and_action: F-START/F-PORT: only with independently working actual owned profile/device/port baseline propose isolated supported failure/lifecycle variants; missing hardware, silent path or unmet capability stays inconclusive.

title: Literal shape and symbol boundary
setup_and_action: F-IDENTITY: compare original string versus string-list declarations as data, retaining unresolved normalization and imported key/property values; no source/helper function is evaluated.

title: Unavailable or mismatched device
setup_and_action: F-IDENTITY: only after separately admitted genuine same-profile positive baseline compare independently known wrong/absent device or firmware. This packet does not acquire or connect hardware.

title: Missing busy or reordered port
setup_and_action: F-PORT: establish real productive device/host ports, then use separately retained supported absent/busy/reordered context and re-resolution; no port failure/pass is inferred from list metadata.

title: Startup cancellation and source loss
setup_and_action: F-START: after known successful genuine profile initialization baseline record offered cancellation/retry and unavailable script/context variants only under separate authorization; no asynchronous cancel or safe-failure guarantee.

title: Nonzero control and feedback baseline
setup_and_action: F-SIGNAL: independently active admitted target/control with nonzero valid input/amount and positive mapped/feedback/output baseline first; test only an independently known supported gesture, without a MIDI byte, LED, clock or audio oracle.

title: Reconnect restart and pending teardown
setup_and_action: F-START/F-PORT: separately propose actual supported reconnect, restart, profile/Set save and close/quit while a productive input/output path is active. Identity/configuration retention, flush, silence and timing remain null.
